patches.notes:
**Dragon Ball** is Bandai's 2003 WonderSwan Color game, released only in Japan. It retells the first Dragon Ball saga, from Goku meeting Bulma to King Piccolo, as a board game: you move along the map with cards, meet the characters of the series, and fight with a card system where stars, move types and numbers decide who hits. Master Roshi, Korin and Mr. Popo train you in the rules.

This patch translates it into English.

> **Please read:** this translation was made **entirely with AI**, as a personal project. It is shared as it is for anyone who wants to play, but it must **never be uploaded to romhacking sites** (romhacking.net and the like): it isn't up to the standard of a real fan translation and it doesn't belong there.

**How to patch**

Apply the .bps to *Dragon Ball (Japan)* (2 MB, CRC32 067238D1) with Floating IPS, beat or ROM Patcher JS. Result: 4 MB, CRC32 21720754. Keep the .wsc extension.

With Floating IPS on the command line:

    flips --apply "Dragon.Ball.T-En.v0.9.1.bps" "Dragon Ball (Japan).wsc" "Dragon Ball (Japan) [T-En v0.9.1].wsc"

You must provide your own copy of the original Japanese game to apply it.

You can also try the patched game in the browser with the web emulator: https://mariovirgili.github.io/wonderswan-web/
